title: Multistage Nonlinear MPC
text: Simulate multistage nonlinear model predictive controllers, 13 inputs, 6 outputs, {Make block run at a different sample time} sets Controller sample time positive finite scalar; {Multistage Nonlinear MPC Controller} sets the controller object nlmpcMultistage object, {Use prediction model sample time} sets the flag for using the prediction model sample, {Use MEX to speed up simulation} sets the flag for simulating controller use MEX, {Specify MEX function name} sets the controller MEX function, {Measured disturbances} adds measured disturbance input port, {StateFcn parameter} adds state function parameters input port, {Stacked stage parameters} adds stage functions parameter input port, {Optimal cost} adds optimal cost output port, {Optimal control sequence} adds optimal control sequence output port, {Optimal state sequence} adds optimal state sequence output port, {Slack variable} adds slack variable output port, {Optimization status} adds optimization status output port, {Lower MV limits} adds minimum MV constraint input port, {Upper MV limits} adds maximum MV constraint input port, {Lower MVRate limits} adds minimum MV rate constraint input port, {Upper MVRate limits} adds maximum MV rate constraint input port, {Lower state limits} adds minimum state constraint input port, {Upper state limits} adds maximum state constraint input port, {Terminal state} and {Initial guess} adds initial guess input port. Values come from the instance.
